sourceEvidence.viewportNote: Frozen source captures are 1280px wide full pages, so desktop is width-matched; mobile is evaluated as a responsive structural translation, not claimed as a same-viewport source recreation.

warmSurfaceRatio.finding: Warm paper is now the dominant host surface in both viewports and moves materially toward the frozen official pages.

darkSurfaceRatio.finding: Dark mass is no longer the page canvas; it is concentrated in the masthead/navigation and small labels.

accentRatios.finding: Desktop accents are source-like and sparse. Mobile yellow/red remain slightly denser because selected taxonomy controls and their borders occupy more of the narrow viewport, but no longer dominate.

geometry.dominantRadius: 2.08px mobile / 4px desktop computed after responsive scaling
geometry.finding: The previous rounded-pill language has been replaced by rectangular tabs, filters, campaign strip and list islands.

pixelChangeFromAttempt3.interpretation: The experiment is a material composition/surface change, not a small palette patch.

closerToOfficial: editorial red rails and compact black metadata labels
breathing space between search, taxonomy, campaign and list
remainingDifferences: The official product page uses a multi-column merchandise grid; the host correctly retains its business-required deck list.
Official pages have richer source-owned promotional media and display typography; this minimum experiment intentionally adds no hero or borrowed screenshot assets.
The host CJK hierarchy is restrained and readable but cannot reproduce the source Latin display voice for Chinese labels without a dedicated compatible CJK display face.

maskedRecognition.reason: Even discounting navy/red/yellow and ignoring Pokémon card art, the paper-dominant massing, hard editorial geometry, content rails and section rhythm are closer to the frozen ONE PIECE page system than to Attempt3's generic dark gaming UI.

siblingRegression.structuralAndVisualFinding: No material sibling-route regression. Non-exact captures differ on at most 1.0677% of pixels and preserve all measured visual-mass ratios; the Plaza-specific structural change is absent from sibling routes.
